# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 84 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49 | Coptic

---

## Saying 84

Jesus said: "When you see your likeness, you are glad. But when you see your images that came into existence before you — which neither die nor are revealed — how much will you be able to endure?"

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Are glad" for rejoice — less elevated but accurate
- "Are revealed" — more precise than "become manifest" for the Coptic passive construction
- "Endure" over "bear" — the weight/challenge of confrontation
